items: CSV export formula-injection guard (=,+,-,@,TAB,CR leads prefixed with ') plus CR/CRLF-aware quoting, shared by all four exporters — Stocked/CSVInterchange.swift, RecipeCSV.swift, KitchenTransferManager.swift, GuestDataStore.swift, InventoryExporter.swift

CSV import parsed CRLF (Excel/Windows) files as a single row because Swift folds \r\n into one Character; shared parser now splits LF/CR/CRLF — Stocked/CSVInterchange.swift (used by RecipeCSV.swift and KitchenTransferManager.swift)

CSV import strips a UTF-8 BOM so the Section header still matches (grocery rows were imported as pantry items) and content sniffing works — Stocked/CSVInterchange.swift, Stocked/KitchenTransferManager.swift
Plain-text list import and CSV sniffing now detect CR/CRLF line breaks (Windows-saved lists were one unparseable line) — Stocked/KitchenTransferManager.swift

CSV import quantities accept decimals and clamp to 1...100000 (negatives/garbage no longer produce negative stock); expiry accepts yyyy-MM-dd at local noon instead of being dropped — Stocked/CSVInterchange.swift, Stocked/KitchenTransferManager.swift
Formula guard is reversed on import so Stocked's own CSVs still round-trip (recipe-removal CSV title matching, kitchen CSV) — Stocked/RecipeCSV.swift, Stocked/KitchenTransferManager.swift

Share Extension accepts URLs delivered as String/Data and text delivered as NSAttributedString/Data/file URL (previously dropped, producing 'Couldn't find the shared item'); text capped at 100k chars — StockedShareExtension/ShareViewController.swift

Share Extension downsamples shared images through ImageIO (2048px, EXIF orientation) instead of fully decoding large photos inside the extension memory budget — StockedShareExtension/ShareViewController.swift
Share Extension writes the screenshot atomically, advertises imagePath only on success, and removes a stale screenshot when a new share has none — StockedShareExtension/ShareViewController.swift
Main app accepts only credential-free absolute http(s) links from the share payload (replaces hasPrefix("http")) — Stocked/SharedRecipeImporter.swift (SharedRecipePayloadPolicy.webURL)

Text-only 'caption + link' shares (TikTok/Instagram style) are routed to the link importer; a bare link is no longer parsed as recipe text; failed scrapes fall back to a shared screenshot — Stocked/SharedRecipeImporter.swift

Shared screenshot is resolved inside the app's own App Group container (stored path ignored), read once and deleted; full shared URLs are no longer logged with public privacy (host only) — Stocked/SharedRecipeImporter.swift
Social og: meta extraction is quote-aware (captions were truncated at the first apostrophe, e.g. "Mom's pasta") — Stocked/SocialImportFetcher.swift
Social HTML entity decoding is a single linear pass (no double-decoding of &lt;, no O(n^2) rescans; NUL/surrogates become spaces) — Stocked/SocialImportFetcher.swift
og:image is entity-decoded, resolved against the page and kept only as https (javascript:/data:/file:/credentialed URLs dropped) — Stocked/SocialImportFetcher.swift
Social fetch refuses non-http(s) schemes and responses above the 3 MB HTML bound before regex work — Stocked/SocialImportFetcher.swift
Pinterest country-host detection no longer matches arbitrary hosts like pinterest.recipes-blog.com (which lost their JSON-LD import) — Stocked/SocialImportDetector.swift
Household last-write-wins treats NaN/inf/negative timestamps as 0 so a corrupt stamp can't pin a record forever or beat every future edit — Stocked/HouseholdMergePolicy.swift
Backup merge-restore preserves list order (Dictionary.values shuffled grocery/meal lists on every restore) and unions staples instead of replacing them — Stocked/DataExport.swift
Backup decode skips only malformed records (lenient per-record fallback) instead of rejecting the whole backup — Stocked/DataExport.swift
Backup restore flushes pending saves immediately so a restore survives an app kill right after 'Backup restored' — Stocked/DataExport.swift
stocked://import share-link payload is size-bounded (2 MB) and scheme/host compared case-insensitively before base64/JSON work on the main actor — Stocked/KitchenTransferManager.swift

Widget VoiceOver: stock and expiring gauges get real labels/values, small/medium stock tiles and detail rows read as single elements; displayed percent clamped to 0...100 via a computed (non-encoded) property — StockedWidgets/StockedWidgets.swift, Stocked/WidgetShared.swift

VoiceOver labels and 44pt targets for unlabeled icon-only controls: month navigation, remove-step, delete-substitution, capacity steppers, font/meal picker close, add custom meal, apply quantity — CookLaterCommandCenterView.swift, CreateRecipeView.swift, DatabasesView.swift, InventoryItemSheets.swift, QuickAccessMenu.swift, MealPlannerSubViews.swift, QuantityInputView.swift

Servings control in Smart Recommendation is a VoiceOver adjustable element (the combined row hid both buttons and announced 'Serves 1' instead of the shown household size) — Stocked/SmartRecommendationView.swift
